newsitem.title: UK: Forties snag could lead to 1-2 day deferrals-trade.
newsitem.headline: Forties snag could lead to 1-2 day deferrals-trade.

text.p: A technical problem which forced a one hour shutdown of the million barrel per day (bpd) North Sea Forties crude export pipeline early on Monday could delay cargo loadings by one or two days, trade sources said.

Companies with equity stakes in fields feeding the Forties stream have been told the full impact of the shutdown on the August loading programmes will not become clear until Tuesday but short deferrals are likely, they said.

"We have been told that the impact on loadings will be known tomorrow when the full extent of the shutdown has become clear but it is likely there will be deferrals of one or two days," said an equity producer.
